title: xAI doubles number of onsite gas turbines at Memphis data center (DCD, 2025-04-11)
notes: DCD (2025-04-11). xAI Colossus, Memphis TN: 35 on-site methane gas turbines (422 MW), >2x the 15 permitted; SRLC alleges Clean Air Act violation. Fossil-fuel proximity confirmed. Major AI DC (Grok), not a Q1-artist model.
